text: たとえば…　きあいパンチ　なんて　わざは　さかなポケモンや　とりポケモンでは　あまり　おぼえられそうに　ないよね　うでが　あって　パンチが　だせそうな　ポケモンに　ためしてみよう！

structure.jp: きあいパンチ　なんて　わざは
さかなポケモンや　とりポケモンでは
structure.en: with fish Pokémon or bird Pokémon

structure.jp: あまり　おぼえられそうに　ないよね
パンチが　だせそうな　ポケモンに
structure.en: on a Pokémon that looks like it could throw a punch

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.span: おぼえられそうに　ない
patterns.explanation: そう added to a verb says 'it looks like it will', and そうにない says 'it doesn't look like it will'. おぼえられそうに ない = 'doesn't look able to learn it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing だす to だせる says that it can be done, and そうな adds 'looks like'. パンチが だせそうな = 'that looks like it could throw a punch'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means doing something to see how it goes, and the よう ending means 'let's'. ためしてみよう = 'let's try it out'.
